tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Unequal split composition with edge-aligned media. Large color fields create memorable pairings rather than soft atmosphere.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts are stored or specified as destination assets.
tokens.role: Use expressive display type with quieter utility text. Typography participates in the composition instead of sitting above it.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: Color roles are analytical; preview colors are original and non-exact.
tokens.role: Creative work and imagery carry the story.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.notes: Behavioral priority must be revalidated in the destination product.
tokens.role: Unequal columns and edge relationships create tension without disorder.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Asymmetric editorial field with oversized type and one dominant image slot. Use separate product, photography, illustration, and data roles.
